why: Pins what this package ships so an installed tree can be proven equal to its source. Versions here are the skills' own declared versions; check-ghl-hybrid-parity.sh fails when they drift, so a skill change and its version bump move together.

candidate.note: Records the onboarding branch + SHA each WF00-WF35 unit was built from, re-read from `git ls-remote --heads origin` at generation time; a unit absent on origin is recorded absent with the exact ref checked, the query, and the alternate refs found. Nothing is copied from an earlier candidate.
candidate.self_invalidating: generated_at (UTC) + max_age_seconds. P5 of the parity gate fails when the candidate is older than max_age_seconds, when main has moved, when any recorded sha no longer equals live origin, when a recorded-present ref has vanished, when a recorded-absent ref now exists, or when the candidate omits any unit WF00-WF35. Regenerate with the generator before integrating; never hand-edit a sha.
